wiktionary.gloss: One who sneers.

thesaurus.definition: an advocate of the extension of voting rights (especially to women)

vi_block: Người tán thành mở rộng quyền bầu cử (đặc biệt là cho phụ nữ).

wiktionary.gloss: A person who promotes suffrage.
One who votes.
Of, relating to, or promoting suffrage.

senses.definition: A substance, especially an artificial chemical, added to food or drink instead of sugar.

examples.en: I prefer using an artificial sweetener in my coffee.
examples.vi: Tôi thích dùng chất làm ngọt nhân tạo trong cà phê của mình hơn.

senses.vi: chất pha cho ngọt; chất làm ngọt

senses.definition: Something extra offered in business to persuade someone to agree to a deal.

examples.en: The company offered extra vacation days as a sweetener.
examples.vi: Công ty đã đề nghị thêm ngày nghỉ phép như một khoản khuyến khích.

senses.vi: khoản khuyến khích; món hời phụ

thesaurus.definition: something added to foods to make them taste sweeter
anything that serves as an enticement

wiktionary.gloss: Something added to food to sweeten its taste, especially an artificial substitute for sugar.
Something given or added to a deal to sweeten another's attitude, especially a bribe or kickback.
A shill bidder at an auction.
Natural light that enters a building through the window.
